steps.content:
Since November 10, N.F. 113, an unusual surge of activity has been detected in BR-002. The 9th Agency has confirmed that it is the work of the Underground.

The Underground's Shepherd is on the move, and their target is undoubtedly BR-002, the largest and most powerful Secondary Black Ring at present. Paradeisos also has its attention on it.

??-03: Ever since the observation of BR-002's field was lost, we've been unable to track the enemy. Their camouflage sorcery might have advanced further. The risk has expanded to an intolerable extent. We can't let the enemy achieve their goal, or we won't be able to prevent the subsequent disasters.

??-03: This will be the first direct confrontation in nearly thirty years. Paradeisian forces will initiate limited intervention. The joint operation plan has been issued to all departments. Be prepared.
??-03: We must win, by any means and at all costs.

8:38 p.m., November 22, N.F. 113
Fifth Command, West District Reconstruction 
Executive Committee

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: The analysis report has been distributed. As you can see, our work in West District is impressive.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: Since the campaign in August, the FAC's BR-002 defense line has been further reinforced. The Black Ring is now well under control. No large-scale contamination leakage has occurred in the past three months, and the wandering Corruptors in West District have been promptly cleaned up.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: The 9th Agency's operations have also achieved significant results. BR-002 is the most effective bait and the battles around it have successfully lured out numerous anti-city-state forces. These underground fanatics who have been lurking and harming West District for years have been consecutively exposed and captured.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: And none of this could have been achieved without the West District Reconstruction Executive Committee's full support!

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: We suppressed the March riots, destroyed the remnants of Rustfire, stabilized the order of West District, and received high recognition from Paradeisos. We've performed our governing functions well and received universal respect. Soon, we'll be able to...

A snicker escapes the audience and the spokesperson is instantly humiliated. His already flushed face is now almost purple. He glares angrily in the direction of the sound, and the first person he sees is Sergeant Matilda Cavendish, straight-backed in her seat.
In the spiritless hall, she's the only person sitting upright and looking serious. She stands out as the sole watcher taking this embarrassing farce seriously.
But the spokesperson doesn't appreciate the respect. All he sees in her mirror-clear eyes is his own incompetence. He's annoyed and needs to take it out on someone.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: Ahem... Among all areas of work, the only lackluster part is the census and population management.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: A large number of West District refugees are evading registration and refusing to accept resettlement by the Executive Committee. Instead, they collude with each other while wandering in the contaminated areas, and even engage in Hypercube smuggling.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: Would you care to explain, Sergeant Matilda? This is your department's job. Since your eccentric superior is not here, we shall hear from you instead.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: That is indeed our job, sir, and I'm glad it's getting your attention. Here is a report about this task and my superior, which I would like you to review.
She connects her device to the conference system. Soon, a shocking field photo emerges on the big screen, making everyone gasp.

It's the last image captured by a damaged security camera: A female Rustfire thug with blue braids is grimacing and flipping her middle finger at the camera overbearingly, her other hand gripping her prey, a male Executive Officer being tortured.

The poor Executive Officer's sunglasses are shattered and his eyes are unfocused. His body is twisted in his disheveled clothes, and his face is covered in insulting patterns painted with blood, under which lies a contorted expression of horror.

The camera quickly moves to some ludicrous graffiti on the wall, but what was shown has already traumatized the Executive Officers. The thought that they could be the next victim makes the attendees restless. They are all whispering now, angry, anxious, and terrified.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The Executive Officer who was attacked is my direct superior, Donald. Three weeks ago, Mr. Donald disappeared while on patrol. This is the last clue we found, no doubt a threat and provocation from the other side.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The violent attacks by the radicals and the nonviolent resistance of ordinary people... all point to one single reason.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Although we have calmed down the Rustfire riots, people's anger remains unresolved. They do not trust the city-state and blame West District's misfortunes on us.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: <size=45>This is pure scaremongering! We are governing West District perfectly!</size>
The spokesperson angrily slaps the desk and interrupts Matilda. The hall falls to silence for a few seconds.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You're right, sir.
She turns off the report screen and resumes her poised sitting posture, as if she has never said anything or exposed any scandals.

steps.speaker: Somber Murmurs
steps.content: ...What a gutsy thing to say. Of course, she's the daughter of the Cavendish family... We risk our lives every day while she's just here to polish her resume and kill time...

steps.speaker: Somber Murmurs
steps.content: Well, if her family had any hope in her, they wouldn't have thrown her to this hellhole and assigned her that figurehead loony superior. I say she's just an outcast in the Cavendish family, haha...
...Mind your own business.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: ...Ahem. I feel sorry for Donald, but your superior is notoriously prone to getting into trouble. If he had followed the Executive Committee's guidelines, he would never have ended up like this.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: Paradeisos has issued new instructions to all departments. Another large-scale joint operation concerning BR-002 will be launched within two weeks. The battle against the Underground's Mania forces has entered a critical stage, and the Executive Committee has also received important tasks.

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: The remaining population in West District must complete the registration for systematic governance and resettlement. All who do not comply are suspected of rebellion. Find and destroy their organizations. If the operation is successful, you can all return to Eastside!

steps.speaker: Spokesperson
steps.content: Sergeant Matilda, you will perform field duties in your missing superior's place. You can do it, can't you?
A few sneers echo in the hall with brazen surprise and schadenfreude. After all, who would willingly undertake field duties during this time? As said in Matilda's report, it's a gamble on your life.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Copy that, sir. I'll get right to it.
She gets up and leaves the meeting room, ignoring the hushed mockery along the way.

steps.speaker: Somber Murmurs
steps.content: Serves the nepo baby right...

<size=40><color=#fb9259>Matilda Cavendish</color> became a <size=40><color=#fb9259>clerk for the Executive Committee</color> in N.F. 112.

She is rigid, solitary, inflexible, and lacks political acumen.

The only reason she's still here is because people fear her family and her aunt who is expected to be elected the future Speaker of the Eastside City Council.</size>

<size=40>However, the Cavendish family has not taken her back to safety since the West District uprising six months ago.

People gradually realize that Matilda is more of an outcast than a promising Cavendish who's placed here to enrich her resume.</size>
<size=40>Perhaps even her family hopes she will die quietly on the battlefield in exchange for a glamorous medal of honor.</size>
Clang—
Worries always come true. On a Syndican street, a blue-haired Rustfire Sinner smashes off a robot guard with a club, looking down at the terrified Executive Officers smugly.

steps.speaker: Panicking Officer
steps.content: No, no... We didn't do anything. We were just doing our job. Please don't kill me, please!

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Hey, I've warned you. Why are you still wandering around the streets? Are all Executive Officers so dedicated to their job? I'm ******* tearing up.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: I've been quite bored recently. Line up and take turns to be my punching bag.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Aw! Don't run!
The armed Executive Officers flee in panic, leaving only Matilda in the patrol to protect the clerical officers behind her.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: That's a Rustfire Sinner, A-Class. With my gear, I can take her on alone and buy us some time. I'll hold her off, you guys go find reinforcements.

steps.speaker: Panicking Officer
steps.content: B-But... there's more than one Sinner!

In the middle of the dilapidated street, an incongruous figure emerges. Though frail and thin, she radiates a sinister aura. The shrieking Mania alarm and the black mist roaring under her cloak reveal the girl's identity.

Matilda clearly sees the twisted Nightmare rising behind the girl. The highly contaminated environment causes severe signal interference, so the real-time images cannot be transmitted. She calmly types the final telegram in the designated anti-Mania channel.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: To HQ, Matilda's patrol was attacked by an unknown Sinner. Enemy's highly aggressive. Please send reinforcements.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Please send reinforcements.
The moment she finishes typing these words, the wall covering her is crushed by Nightmare's roar.
